summary: ORB broker-isolated paper lifecycle. Re-review at the corrected head; the prior head 9987ba60 was WITHHELD and no record was written for it. Ancestor property checked with the gate's own test (git merge-base --is-ancestor) before anything else. DELTA IS TESTS-ONLY: git diff 9987ba60..ba920cd2 -- src/ ops/ docs/ is EMPTY, so the implementation I verified at the prior head is byte-identical and that verification carries. ALL NINE MUTATIONS RE-DERIVED BY ME, not accepted: target 5->6, stop 8->10, body 45->30, body 45->60 (both directions), atr_exit True->False, and lifecycle_enabled False->True each turn test_shipped_defaults_match_the_settled_dark_paper_rule RED; the ATR gap guard removal turns the across-a-gap parity test RED; ATR factor 3.5->3.0 and period 5->7 each turn 3 RED. THE DEFAULTS TEST IS NOT DOING ALL THE WORK: I separately mutated the BEHAVIOURAL comparison sites (orb_app.py:1017 and :1449, self._paper_min_break_body_pct -> 30.0) and test_break_bar_body_at_40_triggers_the_body_exit turns RED, so the behaviour at 45 is discriminated independently of the shipped value. That pair is what closes my withhold: the fixture tests prove behaviour AT the threshold, the defaults test proves production SHIPS that threshold, and previously neither covered the shipped value. BROKER ISOLATION verified at the prior head and unchanged: the hostile-settings test forces orb_broker_account_name=live:orb with provider webull/schwab/alpaca and webull_account_id=WB-LIVE and still asserts the registration is coerced to ORB_PAPER_ACCOUNT_NAME with execution_mode=paper and provider=none; reverting that coercion turns 4 tests RED including the literal-label one; _NoIntentRedis raises if the paper path reaches the OMS intent stream; there is no place_order, TradeIntent, or adapter surface anywhere in the lifecycle path. RULES MATCH THE SETTLED ORB RULING: +5% target on executable-bid touch, -8% including gap-through, break-bar body under 45% as a SELL rather than a filter, ATR 5/3.5 WILDERS purple-turn after bar close, no clock exit, 04:00 ET session reset. The non-adjacent-bar cap is the correct application of the 2026-07-30 bar-hole lesson where True Range across a hole inflated ATR ~2.4x. ATR parity is asserted against v2's REAL implementation (the test imports strategy_core.schwab_1m_v2), not against copied numbers. SHIPS DARK: orb_paper_lifecycle_enabled defaults False and that default now has its own control. CONTROLLED PAIR on my box, denominator tests/unit: base b753835a 46 failed/3494 passed -> head 46 failed/3512 passed, +18, ZERO new failures, IDENTICAL failure names; the 46 are pre-existing shell-installer/crontab tests that do not run on macOS. codex-2 reported +18 on their own box (55/3485 -> 55/3503), which reconciles. ruff check src tests clean. UNRECONCILED AND IMMATERIAL: codex-2's '109 focused tests' does not reproduce for me (43 across the five changed files, 234 for -k orb); it does not bear on the verdict and I did not rely on it.
